# military operations area (MOA)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeMilitaryOperationsArea`](gmeow-overlayTypeMilitaryOperationsArea.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeMilitaryOperationsArea>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Airspace established outside controlled airspace to segregate certain military activities from IFR traffic and to identify for VFR traffic where these activities are conducted.
